raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: ppx_devtools-optcomp
  version: "0.1"
  build_number: 1

  # ocaml_win-64 ships gcc_* and vs_* at the same version/build; name the track.
  c_toolchain: ${{ "" if unix else c_compiler ~ "_*" }}
  library: ${{ "Library/" if not unix else "" }}
  # static archive paired with the .cmxa: msvc ships .lib, gcc and unix ship .a
  native_lib_ext: ${{ ".lib" if c_compiler == "vs" else ".a" }}
  # ELF machine token `file` prints for the target; checked by the arch test
  elf_arch: ${{ "x86-64" if target_platform == "linux-64" else "aarch64" if target_platform == "linux-aarch64" else "PowerPC" if target_platform == "linux-ppc64le" else "RISC-V" if target_platform == "linux-riscv64" else "S/390" if target_platform == "linux-s390x" else "" }}

package:
  name: ocaml-ppx-devtools-optcomp
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/ocsigen/ppx_devtools/releases/download/${{ version }}/ppx_devtools-${{ version }}.tbz
  sha256: 46ad4e62a213e3c0852c02cd1cc182d88ec89afa284a45a4316cfb3ffc0bcb9c

build:
  number: ${{ build_number }}
  string: ${{ c_compiler ~ "_" if not unix }}h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}
  script:
    - if: unix
      then:
        - dune build --profile=release -p ppx_devtools-optcomp @install
        - dune install --prefix="${PREFIX}" --libdir="${PREFIX}/lib/ocaml" ppx_devtools-optcomp
      else:
        # Plain cmd.exe, not MSYS2 bash: pure OCaml, no stubs, so no wrapper is
        # needed and the backslashed install prefix reaches dune intact. The
        # dune cache trips over mixed path separators on windows.
        # dune install also opens the shared cache; disable it for every dune call
        - set DUNE_CACHE=disabled
        - dune build --cache=disabled --profile=release -p ppx_devtools-optcomp @install
        - if errorlevel 1 exit 1
        - dune install --prefix="%LIBRARY_PREFIX%" --libdir="%LIBRARY_PREFIX%\lib\ocaml" ppx_devtools-optcomp
        - if errorlevel 1 exit 1

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler("ocaml") }}
    - if: not unix and c_compiler == "gcc"
      then:
        - ${{ stdlib("m2w64_c") }}
      else:
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    # ocaml_win-64 >=14 only run-constrains the C compiler; activate it here, once (vs, zig)
    - if: not unix and c_compiler != "gcc"
      then:
        - ${{ compiler("zig") if c_compiler == "zig" else compiler("c") }}
    # compiler("ocaml") renders no toolchain track; name it on windows
    - if: not unix
      then:
        - ocaml_${{ target_platform }} ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.* ${{ c_toolchain }}
    # the cross compiler does not pull the native one; the build runs OCaml on the build machine
    - if: build_platform != target_platform and unix
      then:
        - ocaml_${{ build_platform }} ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.*
        # the cross compiler activates itself (shims, OCAMLLIB, host OCAMLPATH)
        - ocaml_${{ target_platform }} ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.*
    # windows cross: the self-contained gcc track needs no vcvars
    - if: build_platform != target_platform and not unix
      then:
        - ocaml_${{ build_platform }} ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.* gcc_*
    - ocaml-dune >=3.20
  host:
    # library: ocaml's run_export pins the compiler patch version
    - ocaml ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.*
    # the noarch ocaml metapackage does not pin the windows toolchain track
    - if: not unix
      then:
        - ocaml_${{ target_platform }} ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.* ${{ c_toolchain }}
    - ocaml-ppxlib >=0.33
  run:
    - ${{ pin_compatible('ocaml-ppxlib', upper_bound='x.x') }}
  # the ocaml run_export does not encode the windows toolchain track
  run_constraints:
    - if: not unix
      then:
        - ocaml_${{ target_platform }} ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.* ${{ c_toolchain }}
    # installed dune-package declares (lang dune X.Y); older dune cannot read it
    - ${{ pin_compatible('ocaml-dune', lower_bound='x.x', upper_bound=None) }}

tests:
  - package_contents:
      files:
        - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/${{ name }}/META
        - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/${{ name }}/ppx_devtools_optcomp.cma
        - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/${{ name }}/ppx_devtools_optcomp.cmi
        # win-arm64 is bytecode-only upstream: OCaml 5.4 has no arm64 Windows backend
        - if: target_platform != "win-arm64"
          then:
            - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/${{ name }}/ppx_devtools_optcomp.cmxa
            - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/${{ name }}/ppx_devtools_optcomp.cmxs
            - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/${{ name }}/ppx_devtools_optcomp${{ native_lib_ext }}

  # run the ppx only where the target binary can execute natively
  - if: unix and build_platform == target_platform
    then:
      script:
        - export DUNE_CACHE=disabled
        - export OCAMLPATH="${PREFIX}/lib/ocaml${OCAMLPATH:+:$OCAMLPATH}"
        - echo '(lang dune 3.0)' > dune-project
        - echo '(executable (name t) (preprocess (pps ppx_devtools-optcomp)))' > dune
        - printf '%s\n' 'let x = 1 [@@if ocaml_version >= (4, 0, 0)]' 'let y = this_identifier_does_not_exist [@@if ocaml_version < (4, 0, 0)]' 'let () = ignore x; print_string "ok"' > t.ml
        - dune build --root . ./t.exe
        - ./_build/default/t.exe | grep -q ok
      requirements:
        run:
          - ocaml ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.*
          - ocaml-dune >=3.20
          - ${{ compiler("c") }}

  # windows: msys bash drives the same check; no arm64 backend, no cross runs
  - if: win and target_platform != "win-arm64" and build_platform == target_platform
    then:
      script:
        interpreter: bash
        content:
          - export DUNE_CACHE=disabled
          - export OCAMLPATH="${PREFIX}/Library/lib/ocaml${OCAMLPATH:+;$OCAMLPATH}"
          - echo '(lang dune 3.0)' > dune-project
          - echo '(executable (name t) (preprocess (pps ppx_devtools-optcomp)))' > dune
          - printf '%s\n' 'let x = 1 [@@if ocaml_version >= (4, 0, 0)]' 'let y = this_identifier_does_not_exist [@@if ocaml_version < (4, 0, 0)]' 'let () = ignore x; print_string "ok"' > t.ml
          - dune build --root . ./t.exe
          - ./_build/default/t.exe | grep -q ok
      requirements:
        run:
          - ocaml ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.*
          - ocaml_${{ target_platform }} ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.* ${{ c_toolchain }}
          - ocaml-dune >=3.20
          - if: not unix and c_compiler != "gcc"
            then:
              - ${{ compiler("c") }}
          - m2-bash
          - m2-coreutils
          - m2-grep

  # cross lanes test under qemu binfmt, which would also run a build-machine
  # binary; check the native objects' ELF headers name the target instead
  - if: linux
    then:
      script:
        # test scripts are not jinja-rendered; hand the token over by env
        env:
          ELF_ARCH: ${{ elf_arch }}
        content:
          - mkdir -p objs
          - cd objs
          - ar x "${PREFIX}/lib/ocaml/${{ name }}/ppx_devtools_optcomp.a"
          - file -L ./*.o
          - test -z "$(file -L ./*.o | grep -v "${ELF_ARCH}")"
      requirements:
        build:
          - file
          - binutils

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/ocsigen/ppx_devtools
  repository: https://github.com/ocsigen/ppx_devtools
  license: LGPL-2.1-or-later WITH OCaml-LGPL-linking-exception
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Lightweight ppx for conditional compilation
  description: |
    ppx_devtools-optcomp gates code at compile time with [@if] attributes,
    depending on the OCaml version, the operating system or the compiler flavour.

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - MementoRC
    - ManuelLerchner
